## Summary

Trading members are informed that Ratnakar Securities Pvt. Ltd. (Member No. 3251) has amalgamated with Mangalya Soft-Tech Ltd., resulting in a change of name to Ratnakar Securities Limited in the Cash Segment.

## Key Points

- Trading Member Name Change: Ratnakar Securities Pvt. Ltd. to Ratnakar Securities Limited.
- Member Number: 3251.
- Segment: Cash Segment.
- Effective Date: November 23, 2026.

## Regulatory Changes

N/A

## Compliance Requirements

Trading members and market participants must update their records with the new name of the trading member.

## Important Dates

- Effective Date: November 23, 2026

## Impact Assessment

This is an operational name change resulting from amalgamation and has no direct market-wide impact.
